title: Lisabuela Campground

options.name: accessible by bike and Paddle only

services.name: Campsite
services.desc: By Kayak: The Washington Water Trails Association’s website has helpful information for those arriving by water. Look for an abandoned boat on the shore. The kayak rack is located at the north end of the point, followed by a staircase to the 2 campsites. Each site is numbered and there are picnic tables and a sanican

services.name: accessible by bike and Paddle only
services.desc: Both Point Robinson and Lisabeula offer 2 campsites for those arriving by bicycle or paddling to the waters edge. Point Robinson is located on the east side of Maury Island and Lisabeula faces west on Colvos Passage. Two beautiful parks with beach, forest and fresh island
